The CALD Conference on Democratic Resilience & 9th CALD Party Management Workshop is coming to Yogyakarta!

Bringing together political leaders, policymakers, and democracy advocates from across Asia, the conference will explore the challenges and opportunities for strengthening democratic resilience through three key sessions:

🔹 Anatomy of Democratic Backsliding in Southeast Asia
🔹 Holding the Line: Democratic Resilience and Institutional Safeguards in Asia
🔹 Fortifying Democracy: From Backsliding to Resilience

The conference will feature a keynote speech by Hasto Kristiyanto, Secretary-General of PDI Perjuangan, alongside opening remarks from representatives of CALD and the Friedrich Naumann Foundation for Freedom Asia.

🌏 Join the conversation. Connect across borders. Strengthen democracy.

Register through the QR code. Eligible participants will receive an email confirmation by 3 September 2026.

Don’t miss the opportunity to be part of this important cross-border dialogue on the future of democracy in Asia.

#CALDConference #DemocraticResilience #Yogyakarta2026 #CouncilOfAsianLiberalsAndDemocrats
